aggregation: Report all 36 planned slots and per-case values; equal mean over 3 source groups within each config/condition. No headline CI/significance or generalization claim with n=3 and one training seed.
failure: Missing output, budget stop, NaN/Inf, wrong length/frame/mask, checkpoint/data/noise hash mismatch are retained in failure_rate over all planned slots; numerical means explicitly state finite-count denominators.
alignment: Use delivered canonical frame and exact 20Hz timestamps; no GT yaw fit, translation fit, Procrustes, temporal search or length stretching on generated outputs.

continuous_metrics.global_MPJPE_m: mean norm(output[t,j]-GT[t,j]) over valid 22 joints and all target frames
continuous_metrics.root_relative_MPJPE_m: subtract each motion own pelvis at each frame, then mean joint Euclidean error
continuous_metrics.root_path_RMSE_m: sqrt(mean squared Euclidean pelvis error)), no fitted translation
continuous_metrics.head_or_wrists_position_joint_proxy_m: mean Euclidean error at joint 15 for head or joints 20/21 for wrists; NOT mounted vertex acceleration/orientation
continuous_metrics.velocity_joint_proxy_RMSE_m_s: forward first difference at 20Hz on adjacent valid frames, sqrt(mean squared Euclidean difference to GT))
continuous_metrics.jerk_absolute_m_s3: mean Euclidean norm of third forward difference *20^3 over valid four-frame stencils; report GT alongside; no ratio or smaller-is-better claim
continuous_metrics.motion_extent_m: per-axis min/max extent and pelvis path length; report GT alongside to expose static/collapsed outputs
continuous_metrics.foot_contact_speed_proxy_m_s: on 000433/000382 only, mean generated ankle/foot speed at frames marked contact by delivered GT last 4 feature channels; diagnostic, not calibrated physical slip
continuous_metrics.flat_floor_quality_for_000139: not_applicable: GT rises approximately .64m on nonflat support; do not treat all raised feet as penetration/sliding failures
continuous_metrics.strict_null_vs_backbone_max_abs_m: same text/noise/length decoded coordinate max difference; report continuous result and numerical replay status

semantic_review: Owner02 reviews all outputs in randomized condition order against original coarse action/order: kick cycle then standing (000433), repeated hand approach/separation then arms down (000382), standing/sway then forward steps/arm swing (000139). Save review notes and failure cases; no automatic semantic pass threshold or JSR from these labels.
normalization: Use fixed pretrained motion Mean/Std for decoding; use checkpoint-bound new train-only IMU stats for input. Save all hashes.
